messages:
ivy: Heads-up: launching the Interactive Evals Harness (preview) today at 11:00 PT. Purpose: let devs run prompt suites against multiple model variants straight from docs. :rocket:

ivy: This is a docs-first tool — low-friction runs, labeled outputs, and a compare view. Itoes NOT expose customer data to other orgs.

sam: Nice. Retention policy for the eval runs?

ivy: Good q. Default retention: 30 days for interactive runs, 365 days for saved evals if the org opts in. We're adding an org-level flag to shorten/extend retention.

lee: Any policy changes required for exported evals?

ivy: Exported eval bundles are now gated by an approval flow for orgs marked "sensitive". CLI snippet to opt-in/opt-out:
```bash
redwood admin evals set-retention --org=my-org --days=90
```

maria: Docs: I added the quickstart + security section, including how to make evals private and scrub responses. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/evals/interactive-preview

docbot: docs/changeset created: changes/2026-04-01-interactive-evals-preview.md preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/changes/2026-04-01-evals

qa-bot: perf test: harness adds ~80ms median to run time vs headless scripts; within SLA.

ops: We'll enable feature flag `docs.interactive_evals` for 10% of orgs now, ramp to 100% over 48h.

ivy: Action items: 1) Docs: finalize scrub examples (maria). 2) Eng: add metric `eval_export_attempts` and alert on >5/day per org (sam). 3) Support: prepare KB entry.

sam: I'll create the metric ticket and a simple dashboard.

ivy: Thanks all. We'll post a blog post and in-console notice tomorrow and monitor privacy metrics closely. Ping me for access or questions. END THREAD
